description: Original Medicare applies prior authorization only through named programs, each covering a defined set of items or services. Each program is recorded as a closed list, and each is screened for the ESA concept: a reviewer confirms the concept is outside the program's list. The resolver gives 'not required' only when every program bound to the coverage, state and date has been screened (proposal section 10.4). The program set comes from the CMS program statistics for fiscal year 2024, the WISeR fact sheet and the CMS pages for the ASC demonstration, the DMEPOS probationary process and the IRF demonstration expansion (found 2026-11-12); the CMS index of initiatives is the check that the set is complete; WISeR states that its codes do not overlap with the existing programs.
